# Reelywood - AI-Powered Production House & Business Automation SaaS

Reelywood is a hybrid creative production house and SaaS company based in Vadodara, Gujarat. We specialize in two main areas:
1. **Creative Production:** High-end AI Reels, AI-generated content (AIGC), and editorial-style storytelling that drives performance.
2. **Business Automation SaaS:** Tools for local and regional businesses to automate their WhatsApp, CRM, and marketing operations.
